name: SolverRefusal
message:
solverBot(c1) chest (880,816) stance: the combat ladder is EXHAUSTED. The corridor passes through danger at (744.3,723.2) — spinner:spinner@880,848 (a live Spinner BODY at (740.9,728.7) at horizon 460 — `Enemy.hitPlayer`'s 7x7 `collide("Player", x, y)` at force 3) — and every rung of ⚖ §11.8a's order refused:
  avoid: no admissible corridor with the danger map's 17 volume(s) forbidden — A* goal tile (55,52) in level 40 — for (888,834) — is not walkable: danger:bobsoldier@880,832 (a stepped bobsoldier at its LIVE position) at (868,822). The planner works in whole tiles, so both ends o
  time: the aim is 406 px away and `mover.MOVER_RANGE` measures this search reaching 48 px as an UPPER BOUND at dwell 4. TIME is the contested LAST-MILE tool (kickoff §3.1); it is not a room-crossing one, and the bound is named rather than widened.
  bait: spinner@880,848 is a Spinner: a billiard whose `v` reflects off walls and never turns toward the player, so there is no line to bend. That is a KILL question, and the kill is the player's own press.
  kill: spinner@880,848 is a live Spinner whose removal the run OBSERVES (the `spinnerBodies` roster, and `spinnerWrites` for a tagged body), but the run's `primary` slot fires `ghostsword` — the kill this rung derives is a SWORD press (`KILL_ARM_POLICY.Spinner`). The sword is a SUB-ORDER the macro layer owes.
